# Archive

This public archive is a curated pointer page. Raw scratch notes, historical
TODOs, and obsolete repository-structure drafts are kept under
`.agents/archive/docs/` so they remain available to agents without being
published as reader-facing documentation.

Current project direction lives in the [roadmap](../../typst/thesis/development/roadmap.typ) and
[research questions](../../typst/thesis/sections/01-research-questions.typ). Active implementation work lives
in the `.agents/*.toml` backlog, and canonical terms live in the
[glossary](../glossary.qmd).

## Historical Seminar Material

- [Main Seminar Findings Archive](main_seminar_findings.qmd): historical visual
  findings from the main seminar phase, retained as public archive material.
